skill.description: Build and validate small interactive task-style interfaces from behavioral evidence using an explicit state model, stable selectors, persistence boundaries, and scenario-based checks.
skill.scope: Applies to browser or UI tasks whose evidence specifies add/edit/delete, completion, filtering, persistence, validation, accessibility, and responsive behavior. It is a reusable implementation and validation method, not a product template.

resource_event_count_limitation: Historical Runtime resource_events includes directory listing. Directory enumeration is not counted as reading or executing a reusable resource.
